settings.composer_description: Choose which buttons the chat composer shows: file uploads, voice input and voice conversations.
settings.file_uploads_help_1: Visitors can attach a PDF file or an image and ask questions about it.
settings.file_uploads_help_2: The agent's own AI model answers when it can read PDF files and images. If it can't, the model your platform admin picked for file uploads answers. When file uploads are off on the platform, the button stays hidden.

settings.store_conversations_help_2: When off, nothing is saved on our side. The logged-in chatter can still see their own messages in the chat window during their session, but those messages aren't persisted — only that chatter can see them, and they're gone once the session ends.
settings.store_conversations_hint: When off, messages aren't saved — so the analytics below can't collect data either.
settings.analytics_description: Choose which conversation insights this agent collects. Turning one off stops the analysis and hides its dashboard.
settings.sentiment_help_1: After each chat, the model reads the conversation and labels the overall mood as positive, neutral, or negative.
settings.sentiment_help_2: The results roll up on the Sentiment dashboard so you can spot unhappy visitors and watch trends over time. Needs Store conversations on — there's nothing to analyze otherwise.
settings.sentiment_hint: Track whether visitors feel positive, neutral or negative.
settings.tone_help_1: Tone looks at how visitors express themselves — friendly, frustrated, curious, and more — rather than just positive or negative.
settings.tone_help_2: It's detected automatically after each chat and feeds the Tone dashboard, so you can see how people tend to approach your agent. Needs Store conversations on.
settings.tone_hint: Track the communication style — friendly, frustrated, curious and more.
settings.topics_help_1: Topics scans conversations and groups them by what people ask about, so you don't have to tag chats by hand.
settings.topics_help_2: New topics are detected automatically and rolled up on the Topics dashboard, showing you the most common themes. Needs Store conversations on.
settings.topics_hint: Automatically detect and group what visitors ask about.
settings.voice_conversation_hint: Show a button beside the microphone that starts a live spoken call with the agent.
settings.voice_conversation_unavailable: Not set up on this server. An admin can turn on voice conversations in the admin panel.
settings.voice_conversation_help_1: Visitors talk with the agent out loud. It answers from its knowledge and can use its tools that need no approval. Both sides of the call are saved in Chat Logs.
settings.voice_conversation_help_2: Each spoken answer counts as one message. A voice call costs much more to run than a typed chat.
settings.voice_input_unavailable: Not set up on this server. An admin can turn on speech to text in the admin panel.
settings.file_uploads_unavailable: Off on this server. An admin can turn on chat file uploads in the admin panel, under Settings → AI models.
